verdicts.title: The motivic fundamental group of a punctured elliptic curve and algebraic cycles
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we consider the motivic fundamental group of the punctured elliptic curves as a DG complex in the DG category of elliptic motives and describe its resolution via Schur complexes. During this process, we find the algebraic cycles analogous to the Bloch-Totaro cycles.
